neighbours.label: the intensifier ' very'
fire: Most bacteria are harmless, but some can make you very sick.
I want you to take this warning very seriously.
The soup was very hot, so we let it cool for a while.
She has been very busy with the new project this month.
The hike was very steep near the top of the hill.
Our neighbors were very kind when we first moved in.
This old laptop is very slow at loading web pages.
The museum was very quiet on a Tuesday morning.
quiet: Most bacteria are harmless, but some can make you quite sick.
I want you to take this warning seriously.
The soup was too hot, so we let it cool for a while.
She has been extremely busy with the new project this month.
The hike was rather steep near the top of the hill.
Our neighbors were so kind when we first moved in.
This old laptop is really slow at loading web pages.
The museum was quiet on a Tuesday morning.

notes: card flags broad and gate-closed echo; ' very' is the most frequent top token (x7). Near misses use other intensifiers.
